senses.gloss: m.(b. h. גּוּפָה, גַּף, cmp. גְּוִיָּה, גֵּוּ)body, person, self.
units: Kidd. 20ᵃ (expl. b’gappo Ex. XXI, 3) בגוּפוֹ נכנס וכ׳ of himself he entered, of himself he shall go out (free, in the seventh year) but not, like a gentile slave, on losing a limb.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 91a:17">Snh. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ ונשמה וכ׳</he> the body and the soul may try to escape judgment (shifting the responsibility one on the other).
Kidd. 37ᵃ, a. fr. חובת הג׳ personal duty, contrad. to ה׳ קרקע laws connected with the (Palestinean) soil.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:6:9">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵈ</cite> top, a. e. <he>אותו הג׳ הקדוש</he> that holy body (saint).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a:3">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>בגוּפָן</he> by defiling their bodies.
Ab. IV, 6 גּוּפוֹ מכובד וכ׳ will himself be honored by men.—Trnsf. Guf, the fictitious storehouse of souls in heaven.
Yeb. 62ᵃ, a. e. the son of David shall not come עד שיכלו … שֶׁבַּגּ׳ before all souls in the Guf are exhausted (i.e. sent to live on earth).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:4">Y. Ber. I, 3ᶜ</cite> <he>גּוּפָהּ של שמע</he> an integral portion of the Sh’ma (confession of faith).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:5:3">Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵃ</cite> top <he>גופה של פתילה</he> the wick itself.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 9:3">Gitt. IX, 3</cite> <he>גּוּפוֹ של גט וכ׳</he> the essential formula of a letter of divorce is &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 74b:15">Yoma 74ᵇ</cite> <he>גופו של מעשה</he> the deed (of sexual gratification) itself; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Pesachim 112b:11">Pes. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>מצוה וגוף גדול עושה פירות ולו שכר</he> (Ar. a. Ms. M. 2 a. O., ed. <cite ref="F00059"><he>ולא</he></cite>) a charity and at the same time a good investment is the act of him who helps to produce fruits, while he has the reward (e.g. one who loans money to a husbandman on security, allowing payment in small instalments); <he>מצוה וג׳ טהור וכ׳</he> a religious act by which one preserves his body pure does he perform who marries a wife &c.—Pl. <he>גּוּפִין</he>, constr. <he>גּוּפֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:7:2">Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ג׳ הלכות</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 2:10">Tosef. ib. II, 10</cite> <he>ג׳ תורה</he> essential parts of the Law; <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:18">Ab. III, 18</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:8">Ḥag. I, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Chagigah 10a:5">10ᵃ</cite>); 11ᵇ
<cite ref="Menachot 44a:2">Men. 44ᵃ</cite> top <he>גופו דומה וכ׳</he> its color resembles that of the Sea, contrad. to <he>ברייה</he> shape; Mass. Tsitsith ed. Kirchheim p. 23.
